definitions.explanation: A dwarf planet beyond Neptune, classified as a planet until 2006 when it was reclassified as a dwarf planet ({準惑星|じゅんわくせい}).

examples.japanese: {冥王星|めいおうせい}は{準惑星|じゅんわくせい}に{分類|ぶんるい}された。
examples.english: Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}は{冥王星|めいおうせい}も{太陽系|たいようけい}の{惑星|わくせい}だった。
examples.english: Pluto used to be one of the planets in the solar system.

examples.japanese: {冥王星|めいおうせい}は{二〇〇六年|にせんろくねん}に{惑星|わくせい}の{定義|ていぎ}から{外|はず}された。
examples.english: Pluto was removed from the definition of a planet in 2006.

notes:
Named after Pluto, Roman god of the underworld — written with {冥|めい} (underworld/dark) + {王|おう} (king) + {星|せい} (planet). Now formally a {準惑星|じゅんわくせい} (dwarf planet) rather than a full planet.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冥王星|めいおうせい}の{衛星|えいせい}: Pluto's moons
- {冥王星|めいおうせい}の{発見|はっけん}: the discovery of Pluto
- {冥王星|めいおうせい}を{探査|たんさ}する: to explore Pluto

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {準惑星|じゅんわくせい}: dwarf planet — the official category that Pluto now belongs to
- {太陽系|たいようけい}: solar system
